scope: Remove formation restriction for the experimental packed kernel and split scheduler at 50000 units. Lower population behavior is unchanged.

cpuCompare.note: Both phases run within one display frame. Compares total tick cost and hashes per formation; cannot establish frame pacing.

frameCompare.control: Original unpacked Burst single-thread whole tick
frameCompare.candidate: Packed Burst single-thread with split display-frame scheduling
frameCompare.note: Measures combined packed and split effect. Each formation has independent results and acceptance; no isolated attribution to split alone. One forward-order pair per mode needs follow-up if differences are marginal.

localVerification.note: Front checked every committed tick; other formations at 30-tick checkpoints and end. Tick counts checked every display frame. Editor correctness only.
